findings.title: Sharon Regional Medical Center pauses inpatient services; emergency department remains open
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Sharon Regional Medical Center in Pennsylvania has paused inpatient services after struggling to meet payroll
findings.service_line: Inpatient hospital care (specific wards and specialties unconfirmed); emergency department remains open
findings.access_consequences: Inpatient admissions/services have been paused; the report says the hospital would arrange transfers to other facilities if the pause continues. Actual patient transfer count, inpatient bed count and reopening date are unknown.
findings.affected_population: Patients requiring inpatient care in Sharon and the surrounding Mercer County catchment; exact number unknown
